Dear Martin,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0415451 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
We have check last 2 weeks logs and found a lot of IMD (PE connection interrupted) error flags.
Upon further analysis, found that IMD is not getting initialed during the cable check which is suspending the session.
Could you please plan a site visit to check all the connections for the IMD_BC2, mainly PE connections and Relay connections.
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.

afonso-sousa@siemens.com
